name: Tsuchida Sachie
source:
A VIP on Twilight Island and the eldest daughter of Tsuchida Fumiko. To her mother's chagrin, she's quite independent. She's pretty and a fixture in social circles on the mainland.

[Taken from the official character profile in the game]
